description: Creates a new empty project in the connected account, with the default calendar (Mon-Fri, 8:00-13:00 and 14:00-17:00) and the account owner as project owner. Returns the projectId for adding tasks. Calling it twice creates two projects. Requires write permission.

currency.description: ISO currency code, e.g. EUR or USD. Default EUR.

deadline.description: Project deadline YYYY-MM-DD: it does not move dates, it flags when the plan exceeds it.

key.description: Project key (2-10 letters/digits, starting with a letter, e.g. 'Cronos'): tasks are numbered Cronos-1, Cronos-2, ... Fixed once the first task exists. Omitted = derived from the name.

name: planitude_create_project
title: Create empty project
